item.title: Experts: since June, $100M+ in US data center freight has been stolen; in two successful heists, robbers struck escorts protecting trucks hauling $10M+ in goods (Lisa Cavazuti/NBC News)
item.description:
Lisa Cavazuti / NBC News:
Experts: since June, $100M+ in US data center freight has been stolen; in two successful heists, robbers struck escorts protecting trucks hauling $10M+ in goods  —  Trucking, supply chain and security industry veterans detailed to NBC News how thieves staged dramatic robberies as part of the growing theft of tech equipment.

Original (direct link): https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/security/grand-theft-ai-highway-thieves-are-stealing-millions-data-center-gear-rcna603733

item.title: China's Star 50 index of AI and chip leaders is down by 40% in under four months, losing ~$480B in market value; chipmaker CXMT is down ~25% in the past month (Reuters)
item.description:
Reuters:
China's Star 50 index of AI and chip leaders is down by 40% in under four months, losing ~$480B in market value; chipmaker CXMT is down ~25% in the past month  —  While global tech stocks teeter, in China they have already crashed as lofty valuations collapse under worries about AI demand and curbs on Chinese exports.

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-ai-bubble-has-already-burst-2026-10-26/

item.title: Ahead of US midterms, ChatGPT draws images "depicting election interference or that may discourage voting" in a cartoon style, ignoring photorealism requests (Katelyn Chedraoui/CNET)
item.description:
Katelyn Chedraoui / CNET:
Ahead of US midterms, ChatGPT draws images “depicting election interference or that may discourage voting” in a cartoon style, ignoring photorealism requests  —  ChatGPT is cracking down on photorealistic, political deepfakes ahead of next week's US midterm elections.  —  Reporter 2

Original (direct link): https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/openai-chatgpt-political-deepfakes-defense-midterm-elections/

item.title: Fitbit Edge review: notable upgrade over the Charge 6 for GPS and heart rate, Google Health app is an improvement, but lacks software polish and NFC payments (Ray Maker/DC Rainmaker)
item.description:

Original (direct link): https://www.dcrainmaker.com/2026/10/fitbit-edge-depth-review-worth-the-upgrade.html

item.title: Intel agrees to acquire Tel Aviv-based quantum computing startup Classiq; Classiq has raised more than $200M in funding and has about 130 employees (Ian King/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Ian King / Bloomberg:
Intel agrees to acquire Tel Aviv-based quantum computing startup Classiq; Classiq has raised more than $200M in funding and has about 130 employees  —  Intel Corp. agreed to buy Israeli startup Classiq Technologies Ltd. as part of a push to capitalize on quantum computing, a still-nascent field that is seeking commercial applications.
